children: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, Inc. Sponsored ADR (TSE:8306) faces scrutiny in South Korea over large offshore bond deals even as MUFG expands rupee‑bond operations in India, joins a $457M loan for Chilean clean‑energy projects, and gains SWIFT board influence via Noritoshi Murakami.
Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, Inc. Sponsored ADR Named Among Foreign Banks Flagged By South Korea
: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (ADR 8306) is named among foreign banks flagged by South Korea for arranging large offshore bond sales; Seoul seeks market feedback before deciding on a ban.
Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, Inc. Sponsored ADR MUFG’s India Arm Manages Rupee Bonds
: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (8306): MUFG’s India arm has managed ~57 billion rupees in rupee bonds since Sept 2025, plans to expand rupee-bond business, boost market share and IPO participation.
MUFG (8306) Noritoshi Murakami On SWIFT Supervisory Board
: MUFG (8306) is represented by Noritoshi Murakami on SWIFT’s new 15-member supervisory board overseeing strategy, risk and controls as SWIFT shifts governance and advances blockchain and AI payments
Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, Inc. Sponsored ADR Joins Grenergy Chile Loan
: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (8306) via MUFG Bank joined a $457M senior non‑recourse loan for Grenergy’s Chile projects—446 MW solar, 1.8 GWh storage; Algarrobal has a 12‑year PPA from 2028.
